remarks: Welcome to desirable Strawberry Woods! This end-unit townhouse sits in a private spot of the community, just 1/2 mile to Route 1 shops and dining and minutes to Westport Center. Warm and inviting the moment you enter, this updated 2 bed / 2.5 bath home offers an ideal blend of charm, comfort, and convenience.  The main floor features an updated kitchen. A dining area opens to the spacious living room with wood-burning fireplace and French doors to a private deck overlooking a tree-lined backyard - perfect for dining or relaxing. A powder room completes the main level.  Upstairs, both bedrooms feature large windows, and double closets. Two full baths offer privacy for each bedroom. One bedroom boasts an additional outdoor balcony.  A bright lower level with windows provides even more flexible space. Great space for a playroom/office/flex space with storage and laundry.  Community amenities include a pool, reserved parking plus ample visitor parking, and beautifully maintained grounds (with fresh paving and exterior painting underway).  A wonderful and convenient place to call home!
